Subject: Intimation under Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing

Earnings Conference Call for 2nd Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026. 
 
Dear Sir/Ma’am, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Audio Recording Link of Earnings Call for all 
Investors/General Public held today i.e. October 27, 2026 to discuss Operational and Financial 
performance for the 2nd Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026, is available on the website 
of the Company and can be accessed at below mentioned link: 
 
https://www.lumaxworld.in/lumaxindustries/transcript.html 
 
You are requested to kindly take the same in your records. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For Lumax Industries Limited
